title: Senior Penetration Tester  OSCP and CREST Certified
description:
Company: Borderless CS Private Limited
 Industry: Cybersecurity / Information Security
 Job Location: India
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Experience: min 6-10 Years
 Department: Cybersecurity Offensive Security
 
 Job Category: IT & Information Security 
 About Borderless CS 
 Borderless CS is an Australian-headquartered cybersecurity company providing professional security services to clients across Australia and the Asia-Pacific region. 
 We are a CREST-accredited cybersecurity organisation , specialising in penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, managed SOC/MDR, incident response and cybersecurity compliance. 
 We are looking for skilled, motivated and technically strong Penetration Testers holding OSCP and CREST certifications to join our growing cybersecurity team in India. 
 The successful candidates will work on challenging security assessments for Australian enterprise, government and commercial clients. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Conduct comprehensive penetration testing of web applications, REST/GraphQL APIs, mobile applications, internal and external networks, and cloud environments. Perform manual security testing using OWASP WSTG, OWASP API Security Top 10, OWASP MASVS, PTES and recognised industry methodologies. Identify and validate vulnerabilities, including authentication bypass, broken access controls, IDOR/BOLA, injection, SSRF, privilege escalation and business logic flaws. Conduct Active Directory security assessments, internal network penetration testing and privilege escalation testing. Perform authenticated and unauthenticated security assessments. Use industry-standard tools including Burp Suite Professional, Nmap, Metasploit, Nessus, Nuclei, Wireshark and Kali Linux. Prepare high-quality technical penetration testing reports with clear evidence, risk ratings, business impact and remediation recommendations. Conduct vulnerability retesting and verify remediation effectiveness. Work closely with Australian project managers, technical leads and client stakeholders. Follow CREST testing methodologies, quality assurance processes and strict client confidentiality requirements. 
 Required Qualifications and Skills 
 OSCP (OffSec Certified Professional) - Must CREST CRT/CCT certification. - Must Minimum 6 years of hands-on penetration testing experience. Strong practical experience in web application, API and Mobile penetration testing. Experience conducting infrastructure and network penetration testing. Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, CVSS, MITRE ATT&CK and common exploitation techniques. Proficiency in manual vulnerability identification, exploitation and validation. Ability to independently manage assigned penetration testing engagements. Excellent technical report-writing skills in English. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with Australian clients and internal teams. 
 Preferred Qualifications CREST Certified Tester (CCT) or CREST Registered Penetration Tester (CRT). OSCP, OSEP, OSWE, CRTO or equivalent offensive security certifications. Experience testing Android and iOS mobile applications. Experience with Azure, AWS, Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory security assessments. Previous experience working for a CREST-accredited penetration testing organisation. Experience delivering penetration testing services for Australian enterprise or government clients. 
 What We Offer Opportunity to work with an internationally accredited cybersecurity organisation. Exposure to complex Australian enterprise and government security engagements. Career development and professional certification opportunities. Collaborative environment with experienced penetration testers and cybersecurity consultants. Opportunities to develop advanced offensive security skills. Competitive salary based on experience, technical capability and certifications. 
 How to Apply 
 Interested candidates should submit their updated CV, relevant professional certifications and a brief summary of their hands-on penetration testing experience. 
 Subject: Application Penetration Tester (OSCP / CREST Certified) 
 Join Borderless CS and build your career in offensive cybersecurity while supporting international clients.

title: VP Penetration Testing //  Lead Pen Testing

Penetration Testing Cyber security  Engineer
description:
Job description Role & responsibilities :- Application Security Integration: Implement and manage security tools and controls within the CI/CD pipeline to automate security scans, vulnerability management, and policy enforcement for applications in development, staging, and production environments. Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC): Collaborate with software engineers to ensure code is secure by default and follows secure coding standards. Security Automation: Develop and maintain automated security tests for applications, such as static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), and interactive application security testing (IAST), as well as vulnerability management and remediation processes. Application Security Assessment: perform security assessments on web, thick and mobile applications (Both Android & IOS). Collaboration & Training: Act as a liaison between development, security, and operations teams to ensure security practices are well understood and integrated into the existing workflows. Conduct security training sessions for developers to increase awareness of secure coding practices. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Preferred candidate profile :- Experience with Cloud security, Container security and Red-Teaming practices is desirable. Experience in scripting and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell). Qualifications : Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field (or equivalent work experience). 3+ years of experience in DevSecOps, application security, or software security roles. Strong knowledge of application security principles, including secure coding practices, threat modeling, secure architecture, and vulnerability management. Experience with security tools such as static code analysis (SAST), dynamic analysis (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), container security, and vulnerability management platforms. Proficient in DevOps tools: Jenkins, GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes etc. Familiarity with security frameworks and standards, such as OWASP Top 10, NIST, and CIS benchmarks. Strong scripting skills in languages like Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Go. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and understanding of cloud security principles. Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and securing microservices. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams. Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical security concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Certification : Mandatory : Certifications such as Certified Red Team Operator (CRT), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), or GIAC Penetration Tester (GPEN) are highly desirable.
